# Format:  <skill-name>|<relative-path-in-vault>|<tier>
#          <skill-name>|HOST|<tier>   -> installed outside this vault; sync leaves it alone
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Tier comes from scripts/skill-tiers.txt: A = always model-invocable,
# B = installed but hidden from auto-selection, C = not installed.
#
# THIS FILE IS GENERATED - edit scripts/skill-tiers.txt, not this file.
# Rules (see AGENTS.md):
#   * ~/.claude/skills/<name>   is the ONE real copy (canonical store)
#   * ~/.kilo/skills, ~/.codex/skills, ~/.agents/skills are junction views onto it
#   * a skill must appear here to be installed; unlisted skills are never auto-installed
#   * removing a line here + deleting it from the stores is how a skill is retired
#
# Skills retired on 2026-10-25 by the defect audit are absent here and are
# documented in REMOVED-SKILLS.md (reason + upstream copy kept for re-adding).
#

# INSTALL SCOPE: only the top 2 score band(s) of each category are installed.
# Set scripts/install-scope.json -> {"topBandsPerCategory": 0} to install every band.
